stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: From everyone at Wagga Wagga Country Club, welcome Garry Atkinson of Yass GC. Have a great round.

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 3, 4 & 5 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 11, wipe on hole 12 - the course corrects

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Visitor from Moore Park GC sitting 12th - raiding the local silverware

stories.title: From the Movies
stories.detail: Scotty Blandford - the crowd has gone deadly silent, a Cinderella story rolling to 13 pts
